reviews.title: Great Concept, Terrible Subscription Model!
reviews.text:
GoodShort seems like a promising app with some interesting shows, but I absolutely hate the pay-per-episode system and/ or weekly subscription fees. At least they stayed true to their name—GOODSHORT—because the episodes are incredibly short, averaging about 5 minutes each!

The series I found interesting had around 60 episodes, which sounds like a lot until you realize how quickly you can get through them. What makes it worse is there’s no clear indication of when future episodes will be released, leaving you paying for a subscription without knowing when you’ll get more content.

I don’t mind paying for entertainment, but this pricing model feels like a money grab, especially considering how little content you’re actually getting per episode. I’d much rather pay a reasonable monthly subscription for unlimited access.

I canceled my membership ASAP! Good concept, after I cancelled they keep trying to charge the weekly membership fee!!!!

reviews.title: AI Slop
reviews.text:
I don't enjoy AI as a medium for fiction. When I watch a drama, I'm looking for people telling stories. The plot can be as wild and unbelievable as it wants, but I want real writers, real actors, and real creative choices behind it.

Lately this has been releasing so much AI-generated content that it's crowding out the productions I came for. Please label AI content clearly and give us a way to filter it out, or better yet, invest in human-made dramas. Until then, this app isn't for me.

reviews.title: Addictive but SCAMMY
reviews.text: I have had this app for about 2 months. The first week i got sucked into the videos like anyone would, so i paid the $20 for A SINGLE WEEK of the VIP membership. Netflix doesn’t even cost that much for a single week. Afterwards i would check in every day for the free videos because to buy credits it is just as much as the VIP membership. Once you get past 2 weeks of checking in watching a million ads for a meager amount of bonus points and an ad per 2 minute video which you only get 5 per day. It doubles the amount of videos you have to watch in order to watch ONE video and shortens the amount of videos you can watch per day. Its an absolute SCAM. On top of that i took a break from watching videos and decided to stack up my free checkin bonus so i could watch more than one video for free. No they took all my bonus points away. Come to find out if you dont use them right away they expire. The app is so focused on making extra money that they are inconveniencing the users.  Either make the membership monthly for the same price or make the bonus permanent. Nobody wants to waste their time doing tasks for something they dont get to keep and not everyone has the finances to pay for this overpriced app.
